issues.title: ✅ Good Color Independence

issues.title: ✅ Adequate Touch Target Size
issues.description: Interactive elements appear to have adequate size for easy tapping
how_to_fix: Great! Your touch targets appear to be appropriately sized

issues.title: ✅ Minimal Text Content
issues.description: Design has minimal text. Good for visual clarity!
how_to_fix: Great! If text is added, follow readability best practices

summary.focus: Apply these readability best practices to your text content

issues.title: ⚠️ Visual Hierarchy Unclear
issues.description: Different sections appear to have similar visual weight. Users may not know where to focus first
how_to_fix: ✏️ Use size to create hierarchy: Important elements larger, secondary elements smaller
✏️ Use contrast: Important content should stand out with bolder colors or darker text
✏️ Use whitespace: Separate important sections with breathing room
✏️ Use color: Draw attention with color, but not overuse it
✏️ Primary content should be ~60% of the visual space
✏️ Secondary content ~30%, supporting ~10%
✏️ Make the call-to-action (CTA) the most prominent element

issues.title: 🔥 Visual Attention Areas
how_to_fix: ✏️ Your design naturally draws attention to: Bottom-Left, Middle-Left, Top-Left
✏️ Make sure these hot spots contain important content
✏️ If not important, reduce contrast in these areas
✏️ Use high-attention areas for calls-to-action (CTAs)
✏️ Important content should be in prominent positions
✏️ Consider user attention span - focus on 1-2 key messages
✏️ Secondary information should be in lower-attention areas
